channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Yemeni forces strike Sanaa as Trump warns Tehran of hard way
item.description: Fighting in Yemen displaces more civilians, as Trump says a decision on Iran is coming.

item.title: Funeral held at Gaza church for mother and daughter killed in Gaza strike
item.description: Funeral prayers were held at Gaza City’s Saint Porphyrius Greek Orthodox Church for a Palestinian mother and daughter.

item.title: At least 17 people, mostly pilgrims, killed in Kenya road crash
item.description: The multi-vehicle crash occurred in the Salama area, 90km southeast of Nairobi, killing mostly Catholic pilgrims.

item.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
item.description: The man accused of trying to take over the Israel-bound jet is named as Hamam al-Hammami by several media outlets.

item.title: UK-Iranian dual national bailed after RAF Fairford incident arrest
item.description: The 25-year-old man was arrested in the London borough of Westminster on Thursday.

item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
item.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

item.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
item.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.
